# In-place updates and replacement

Attributes that configure a resource change in place. Attributes that identify
it force a replacement. The plan shows which of the two will happen before
anything is applied.

## Attributes updated in place

| Resource | Updatable attributes |
| --- | --- |
| `nemau_instance` | `name`, `description`, `vcpus`, `ram_mb`, `disk_gb`, `security_group_ids`, `started` |
| `nemau_network` | `name`, `description` |
| `nemau_subnet` | `name` |
| `nemau_security_group` | `name`, `description`, `egress_filtering` (`false` to `true` only) |
| `nemau_floating_ip` | `description` |
| `nemau_volume` | `name`, `description`, `size` (increase only) |
| `nemau_container` | `versioning` (not off while `object_lock` is on), `retention_days` (increase only) |
| `nemau_load_balancer` | `name`, `description` |
| `nemau_listener` | `name`, `description`, `connection_limit`, `tls_certificate_ref` |
| `nemau_pool` | `name`, `description`, `lb_algorithm` |
| `nemau_pool_member` | `name`, `weight` |
| `nemau_health_monitor` | `delay`, `timeout`, `max_retries`, `expected_codes` |
| `nemau_dns_zone` | `description`, `email`, `ttl` |
| `nemau_dns_record_set` | `records`, `ttl`, `description` |
| `nemau_kubernetes_cluster` | `kubernetes_version`, `control_plane_replicas`, `default_node_pool.replicas`, `default_node_pool.autoscaler_min`, `default_node_pool.autoscaler_max` |
| `nemau_kubernetes_node_pool` | `replicas`, `autoscaler_min`, `autoscaler_max` |

Changing `vcpus` or `ram_mb` power-cycles the instance. Raising `disk_gb` alone
leaves it running. Changing `kubernetes_version` starts a guided upgrade; see
the `nemau_kubernetes_cluster` page.

## Attributes that force a replacement

| Resource | Immutable | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nemau_keypair` | `name`, `public_key` | the key material identifies the keypair |
| `nemau_snapshot` | everything | a snapshot is a point in time |
| `nemau_security_group_rule` | everything | rules are created and deleted, never edited |
| `nemau_container` | `name`, `object_lock`, `retention_mode` | the name determines the S3 bucket (`s3_bucket`) and S3 has no rename; S3 cannot add object locking to an existing bucket |
| `nemau_container_credential` | everything | a key cannot be edited, only replaced |
| `nemau_dns_zone` | `name` | the name identifies the zone |
| `nemau_dns_record_set` | `name`, `type` | together they address the record set |
| `nemau_instance` | `image_id`, `flavor_id`, `network_id`, `service_level`, `key_name` | they are chosen at creation |
| `nemau_load_balancer` | `vip_subnet_id`, `flavor` | the tier sets the number and size of appliances, and the platform does not resize them in place |
| `nemau_load_balancer_certificate` | everything | a certificate is immutable; renew with `name_prefix` and `create_before_destroy` |
| `nemau_kubernetes_cluster` | `name`, `network_id`, `subnet_id`, `pod_cidr`, `service_cidr`, control-plane sizing, `default_node_pool` name, class, node size, labels and taints | the API addresses the cluster by name; its network is fixed at creation, and a node's size and labels are fixed when the node is built |
| `nemau_kubernetes_node_pool` | `cluster_name`, `name`, `node_class`, node size | same as for the cluster |

Replacing a `nemau_dns_zone` deletes every record in it, so read the plan
before applying such a change.

## Snapshots

Terraform does not restore snapshots. Use `nemau compute snapshot restore <id>`
or one of the SDKs. `size_bytes` and `monthly_cost` report what the snapshot
costs to keep. Deleting an instance deletes its snapshots.
